target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
2024 D055 describes Intel Foundry's strategy to become a major third-party foundry provider while leveraging internal scale and establishing independence. 2025 D033 describes the current state of Intel Foundry (supporting internal products) and the aim to develop a significant external foundry business. Both disclosures cover the same specific topic: Intel Foundry's external foundry business strategy and scope.

Both disclosures describe Intel Foundry's core business strategy and role as a foundry provider. The 2024 disclosure (D052) states Intel Foundry integrates critical components (technology/packaging) to drive innovation as an AI-era foundry. The 2025 disclosure (D033) explicitly states Intel Foundry provides technology development, manufacturing, and advanced packaging services and aims to develop a more significant external foundry business. They share the specific subject of Intel Foundry's strategic business model and service offerings.

sentences.text: As a foundry for the AI era, Intel Foundry brings together these critical components to help drive the next phase of technology innovation.

We also focused on extending our data center infrastructure capabilities by entering into an agreement in August 2024 to acquire ZT Group Int'l, Inc. (ZT Systems), a provider of AI and general purpose compute infrastructure for hyperscale computing companies.
We believe that with the acquisition of ZT Systems, we can accelerate time to market for our leadership AI training and inferencing solutions.

comparisons.peer_topic: Global Technology Scope and Product Portfolio
comparisons.peer_summary: Avago is a global technology leader designing semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions, including AI networking, home connectivity, and software for mainframe and cloud platforms, while also offering fibre channel storage area networking products.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel Foundry and Avago position themselves as global technology leaders driving innovation in the AI era, but they define their roles differently. Intel Foundry specifically describes itself as 'a foundry for the AI era' that integrates technology and packaging to drive innovation, whereas Avago describes itself broadly as a global technology leader designing semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions, including AI networking. Both emphasize their leadership roles in supporting AI infrastructure but differ in specificity regarding the foundry vs. design/software scope.

sentences.text: As a foundry for the AI era, Intel Foundry brings together these critical components to help drive the next phase of technology innovation.
We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions.

We offer thousands of products that are used in end products such as enterprise and data center networking, including artificial intelligence ("AI") networking and connectivity, home connectivity, set-top boxes, broadband access, telecommunication equipment, smartphones and base stations, data center servers and storage systems, factory automation, power generation and alternative energy systems, and electronic displays.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company experienced substantial improvements in pricing and margins in 2024, driven by increased demand growth partly from AI deployment, normal customer inventories, and industry supply discipline.

Intel Foundry discusses its role in integrating components to drive the next phase of technology innovation for AI, while Micron reports that substantial improvements in pricing and margins in 2024 were driven by increased demand growth partly from AI deployment. Intel's disclosure is forward-looking and strategic regarding its foundry role, whereas Micron's is backward-looking and operational regarding financial results driven by AI demand.

sentences.text: As a foundry for the AI era, Intel Foundry brings together these critical components to help drive the next phase of technology innovation.
Throughout 2024, we experienced substantial improvements in pricing and margins.

Increasing demand growth, driven in part by deployment of AI and mostly normal customer inventories, combined with industry-wide supply discipline, resulted in an industry supply and demand balance that substantially improved from 2023 conditions.

comparisons.peer_topic: New Use Cases and Emerging Technology Risks
comparisons.peer_summary: The company introduces products for innovative use cases like DGX Cloud, Omniverse, and generative AI, but demand estimates for these areas may be incorrect, creating revenue or supply volatility. While emerging technologies like generative AI have driven data center demand, their long-term trajectory remains unknown.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel Foundry and NVIDIA discuss their involvement in generative AI and innovation, but Intel Foundry frames its contribution as an enabler (foundry for the AI era) integrating critical components, while NVIDIA highlights the risks associated with its innovative use cases and generative AI products. Intel Foundry states it brings together critical components to help drive the next phase of technology innovation, whereas NVIDIA warns that demand estimates for new use cases like generative AI can be incorrect and create volatility. Intel presents a confident role in the AI ecosystem, while NVIDIA emphasizes the uncertainty of long-term trajectory for such technologies.

sentences.text: As a foundry for the AI era, Intel Foundry brings together these critical components to help drive the next phase of technology innovation.
We build technology and introduce products for new and innovative use cases and applications such as our NVIDIA DGX Cloud services, Omniverse platform, LLMs, and generative AI models.
Recent technologies, such as generative AI models, have emerged, and while they have driven increased demand for Data Center, the long-term trajectory is unknown.

comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm believes that 5G, combined with high-performance computing and on-device AI, will drive adoption in automotive and IoT sectors, and that maintaining leadership in 5G technology development, standardization, and IP licensing is critical for long-term business sustainability.

Intel Foundry discusses its role in integrating technology and packaging offerings to drive innovation as a foundry provider, whereas Qualcomm focuses on 'on-device artificial intelligence' combined with 5G to drive adoption in automotive and IoT sectors. Intel's disclosure is about the manufacturing and integration infrastructure for AI, while Qualcomm's is about the end-user application and connectivity layer enabled by on-device AI.
